name: Yuki Tanaka
goals: Build a real-time streaming data pipeline for content engagement metrics
Create a data quality monitoring system for our data lake
Migrate ETL pipelines from on-prem Informatica to cloud-native
communication_style: Highly technical, talks about partitioning strategies, CAP theorem, idempotency; uses dbt, Spark, Kafka terminology
pain_points: Data lake is a swamp, lineage is unknown, nobody trusts the numbers
Informatica licenses cost $400K/year, board wants cloud migration
Kafka consumer lag spikes every morning at 9am, root cause unknown
sample_prompts: Build a Kafka-based real-time pipeline ingesting clickstream events with exactly-once semantics and a consumer lag monitoring dashboard
Create a data quality framework using Great Expectations over our S3 data lake with automated anomaly alerts and lineage tracking
Design a dbt-based transformation layer replacing our Informatica pipelines with incremental models, tests, and documentation
